title: Big Bugs? BANNED 🚫
excerpt: Our fastest release yet! We smashed a huge number of bugs, introduced Block History, improved Mutual Mode protection, and made Block Mode available to everyone for a limited time.
body:
Big Bugs? BANNED! 🚫 This is one of our fastest releases yet. Just after our previous update, we went straight back into development and eliminated a massive number of bugs, improved stability, and introduced several new systems.

We've also completely upgraded Block Mode with a new Block History system and an Unblock button. And, to celebrate this release, Block Mode is available to everyone for a LIMITED TIME! Seal your blocks in before it's too late.

This update also improves Mutual Mode protection, popup performance, error handling, history controls, uninstall diagnostics, and much more.

added.moreInfo: You can now view users you've blocked through a dedicated Block History system.
Added a dedicated button that lets you quickly unblock users directly from Block History.
Friends are now cached with their original friends-since date for faster access and better friend information.
Added dedicated history icons in the popup and settings instead of using emoji icons.
The uninstall system can now collect detected errors and the user's friend count when they choose to provide feedback.
When you enter a reason for uninstalling Friends Remover, detected errors are collected to help us identify and fix issues.
Block Mode is temporarily available to everyone, including users without FR+.
The Mutual Mode removal screen has been updated to provide better friend-count information and a clearer removal experience.

removed.moreInfo: Removed the broken reCAPTCHA verification system from settings.
Block Mode is no longer permanently restricted to FR+ users.

fixed.moreInfo: Fixed an issue where dismissed users would sometimes fail to show the correct checkmark.
Fixed systems that were not properly respecting the 'Receive Notifications' setting.
Fixed headshots failing to load correctly after switching popup view types.
Fixed pinned and trusted users being incorrectly removable through Mutual Mode.
Fixed the removal button failing to update to 'Remove (count)' when Mutual Mode was enabled in Compact Viewer.
Fixed headshots flashing or displaying incorrectly on the removal screen.
Fixed searching in Compact Viewer incorrectly showing the 'No friends found' error.
Fixed error messages that were difficult to read when Dark Mode was enabled.
Fixed certain texts becoming unreadable depending on the selected theme.
Fixed multiple performance issues causing the popup to feel slow or laggy.
Fixed the 'Switched to Friends List' toast appearing too high on the screen.

improved.moreInfo: Made the popup loading screen more descriptive so users have a better idea of what is happening while the extension loads.
The popup view-switching button now uses an icon that correctly corresponds with the currently selected view.
Block Mode now comes before Mutual Mode when selecting a removal type.
Mutual Mode now provides stronger protection for pinned and trusted users so they cannot accidentally be removed.
Updated history controls and icons across the popup and settings for a cleaner and more consistent experience.
Improved error detection and handling across multiple extension systems.
Uninstall feedback now provides useful diagnostic information that can help identify bugs users experienced before uninstalling.

performance.moreInfo: Reduced popup lag and improved responsiveness across popup interactions.
Caching friend information reduces unnecessary work and makes previously loaded friend data easier to access.

title: A Mobilous Update ⚡
excerpt: Our biggest mobile-focused update yet, with a redesigned mobile experience, new reporting system, improved performance, Block Mode fixes, FR+ improvements, a return of Scrolling Frame, and tons of quality-of-life improvements.
body:
This is one of the biggest Friends Remover updates yet! We completely improved the mobile experience, brought back the classic Scrolling Frame, improved performance, fixed major Block Mode issues, introduced a new reporting system, rebuilt how FR+ activation works, and made countless improvements across the extension.

Mobile users should notice significantly smoother animations, better navigation, improved settings, and less lag overall. We also made major changes to our background monitoring systems to reduce unnecessary Roblox API requests and improve reliability.

added.moreInfo: Users can now report bad users directly from their friends list while using Compact View. After reporting, the user is automatically removed and added to Unfriend History. Free users can submit up to 5 reports per Roblox account per day, while FR+ users can submit up to 15 reports per day. Reports are sent for review, with AI-assisted review followed by manual moderation.
Users can now pin flagged users as long as they are not flagged for child-predator-related reasons. Other flagged categories will still be flagged but will not prevent pinning.
Added a Friends Detail system that mirrors Compact View for users in the classic Friends List.
Added filters that let users filter Unfriend History based on how users were removed.
Added a menu button that lets users quickly switch between Compact View and the classic Friends List directly in the popup.
Mobile users can now choose between swipe navigation and arrow navigation for Compact View in the Settings General tab.
Dark Mode has returned to Friends Remover with a fresh, cleaner appearance.
The classic Scrolling Frame is back and can be enabled through Settings. It includes performance improvements such as 50 friends per page to reduce lag.

added.text: Suspended, Banned, or Deleted Account Detection
added.moreInfo: A custom popup error screen now appears when your Roblox account is suspended, banned, or deleted.
The removal screen now includes a larger profile picture, improved spacing, a progress bar, and an estimated completion time.
FR+ can now be detected through the FR+ role in the Friends Remover group.
Users can now receive a notification when they are granted free FR+ through the group system.

removed.moreInfo: Removed the old Report settings system.
Removed the old Import and Export system from Settings.
Removed the unused update notification system that was originally planned to make older Friends Remover versions unsupported.
Removed the unused GitHub update polling system from background.js.
Removed dynamic polling for background friend-removal checks. Each monitor now uses its own fixed interval.
Removed the empty Advanced tab from Settings on mobile.
Removed the update carousel from mobile Settings.
Removed the old FR+ setup process. Users can now activate FR+ through supported Roblox methods such as group rank and game pass, not our database.
Temporarily removed Auto Remove Flagged Users while the new Friends Remover database is being built.

fixed.moreInfo: Fixed Block Mode completely not working because the wrong Roblox API was being used.
Fixed Block Mode losing its permanent blue theme.
Fixed mobile Settings opening the desktop interface.
Fixed the arrows in Unfriend History being positioned too far away.
Fixed multiple places displaying 'Removal' even when Block Mode was enabled.
Fixed pinned removals creating unnecessary notifications when Auto Re-add is enabled.
When FR+ is lost, all FR+ features now disable properly.

improved.moreInfo: Made popup animations and other mobile systems less demanding, resulting in smoother performance and reduced lag.
Flagged statuses now look like normal status indicators and their tooltips now match the extension.
When a flagged user is pinned, their flagged badge is removed from the current user's view so their normal status is displayed. They will still remain flagged for other users.
Suggest Pins is no longer optional and is automatically enabled.
Warn Bad Players is no longer optional and is automatically enabled.
Removed routine FR+ worker membership checks, including popup and Settings startup checks and worker checks for feature locks, removal speed, history, scheduling, and polling.
FR+ membership is now verified directly through Roblox's game-pass, subscription, and group systems.
Pinned removals now use one notification when Auto Re-add is enabled. Notify if a Friend Removes You will only notify when Auto Re-add is disabled.
Made the popup header slightly bigger and brought back the header animation.

Ban, inactive, pinned, friend-request, external-removal, and flagged-user background checks no longer run at the same time and compete for Roblox API requests. Manual removal and Block Mode still run immediately and can run ahead of background checks.
Updated console logs to make them easier to read.
Added a 1,000 blocked-friend limit check so Block Mode can tell users when they reach Roblox's limit.
Friends List filter selections are now saved locally, fixing the 'No Friends Found' error caused by filters not being remembered correctly.
The popup now automatically removes scheduled users live when their scheduled removal occurs.
Reduced the performance demands of popup animations for mobile users.
Added additional mobile checks and improvements throughout Settings.
